title_en: Xiao Zhang Learns to Trade Stocks
note_en: In 差点把存款全部投进去 "nearly put all his savings in," 把 moves the object 存款 "savings" in front of the verb, and the verb must be followed by a result or direction, here 进去 "in(to it)." English simply says "put X in," but Chinese 把 sentences can't end on a bare verb: 把存款投 is incomplete without 进去.
